name: type-lines
summary: Headline or paragraph rises line by line from behind a mask, once, measured from the real layout.

name: type-scrub
summary: Statement whose words go from muted to full colour in reading order as it scrolls through; reversible, no pinning.

name: marquee-type
summary: Oversized looping line of text with scroll-velocity nudge, pause button, and static wrapped fallback.
